summary: Active Alberta lookout on Baseline Mountain, successor to a 1920s groundhouse; the register and Travel Alberta disagree on its build date.

facts.design: Successor tower and cabin, described in the register as a new 80 ft (24 m) tower

access.note: Active, staffed lookout. Travel Alberta says hikers and off-highway vehicles reach the summit by the main access road, but no source read says the tower may be climbed and none says it is closed.

visit.trail_note: Route guide: the way to the top is the Baseline service road.

facts.agency: Alberta Land & Forest Service (per the register)

events.note: Register: a new 80 ft tower and cabin about half a mile west of the groundhouse was completed by the late 1940s, and the register calls it the successor that remains active. 1948 is a placeholder year for 'late 1940s', not a stated date.
Travel Alberta: the fire tower was upgraded in the 1990s to a new site on the adjacent summit, with an access road. 1990 is a placeholder year; it does not match the register's late-1940s date.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register places the successor tower in the late 1940s, about half a mile west of the groundhouse. Travel Alberta says the tower location was upgraded in the 1990s to the adjacent summit. The story gives both and does not reconcile them. The brief's 2012 has no source read behind it.

notes_for_editor: Covers the present active tower on Baseline Mountain (brief id ca-ab-baseline-2). The original 1920s groundhouse is covered by ca-ab-baseline, which is why this story stays on the successor. The brief's 'built 2012' (Alberta Wildfire year of construction) is not in any source read: the Alberta lookout dataset page is metadata only and its YEAR_CONSTRUCTED values were not readable. The year is therefore left out of the story and events. The register (successor built by the late 1940s) and Travel Alberta (upgraded in the 1990s to the adjacent summit) disagree, and the story says so. The brief's 30 m height has no source, so height_m is omitted. The brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source read; it is recorded as 'restricted'. The 1948 and 1990 event years are placeholders for 'late 1940s' and '1990s', following the convention in ca-ab-baseline. The register entry (registered 1996) describes the groundhouse, so no nhlr_registered event is set for this tower. alltrails.com returned HTTP 403 and was not used.
